name: Yoshimura
source:
The manager of Anteiku. He is a very kind and reasonable ghoul that provides aid and food to ghouls that are incapable of hunting on their own, such as Hinami. 

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Tokyo_Ghoul_characters#Anteiku/Black_Goat]Wikipedia[/url]]
